data_as_of: Futures, VIX, 10Y, DXY, WTI, gold, BTC: Yahoo Finance v7 quotes ~7:40-7:50 a.m. CT (futures delayed ~10 min). Pre-market prices/volumes: StockAnalysis.com quotes and pre-market lists ~7:50-7:51 a.m. CT; Yahoo screener cross-check ~7:50 a.m. CT. Cash closes are Monday Nov 9. CPI released 7:30 a.m. CT.
headline: Futures slip after a hotter-than-expected October CPI (+0.4% m/m, core +0.3%) and Fed Governor Waller's talk of a possible 50 bp December hike; Nasdaq-100 futures −1.2% after Monday's 3.4% rally.
drivers: October CPI, out at 7:30 a.m. CT, rose 0.4% m/m vs 0.3% expected (September +0.6%); core rose 0.3% vs 0.2% expected. The report carried no year-over-year figures because of gaps from last year's government shutdown. Before the data, Fed Governor Waller said in London he leans toward a 25 bp hike in December and that 50 bp should be considered if October inflation ran hot; CME FedWatch already priced >80% odds of a 25 bp hike. Futures turned lower after the print: Nasdaq-100 −1.2% and S&P −0.6%, while the Dow is flat. That follows Monday's rebound (S&P +2.35%, its best day in seven months; Nasdaq-100 +3.4%) led by chips, which are giving back gains this morning (SOXX −2.6%). Nvidia stays under pressure as its board investigates CEO Jensen Huang. Anthropic set its IPO range at $70-$78 on 825M shares (up to ~$64B raised). Oil is down ~3% and the 10-year yield is up ~8 bp to 4.94%.
